exposure: inclusion in the Bolsa Família income transfer program
cohort: 537 children and adolescents in southern Brazil
finding: Cesarean delivery, primiparity, female sex, and age between 5-15 years were associated with a higher risk of obesity in children and adolescents.
mod_finding: Children born via cesarean delivery had a higher risk of obesity.
